status: Pre-edit receiver-body trace; no P06 implementation or acceptance verdict.

application_queries.evidence: Currently accepts Vec2, computes grid coordinates and forwards the same untyped position to UrbanGroundSurfaces::surface_at.
application_queries.decision: Accept the checked point. Keep it checked for the urban branch and project metres only for actual grid-address calculation.

application_queries.evidence: Surfaces is an application forwarder to its retained lookup. Lookup selects semantic material/ownership using bucket and geometric predicates. Vista streets::UrbanGround::suppresses_grass adds another forwarder.
application_queries.decision: Carry ScenePlanPoint through these query/forwarder interfaces. Reuse the existing lowest canonical owner. Do not project in the public forwarder and re-admit in the lookup.

application_queries.evidence: Body directly computes clamped UVs, integer texel addresses and the mask byte. TuftPlacement::coverage currently forwards Vec2 to it.
application_queries.decision: This body is the actual native texture-sampling calculation, but the checked point should reach it through TuftPlacement and botanical-site helpers. Project once inside this calculation; do not classify its callers as native merely because this receiver is native.

application_queries.evidence: The existing checked footprint centre is erased to chain with computed corners; each point is re-admitted separately for the collar and support calls. allows_activity forwards raw coordinates to ground semantics.
application_queries.decision: Admit complete computed corners once, retain the already-checked centre, and use that same checked point through collar, activity and support queries. Keep the native vista grid-address calculation at its actual boundary.

application_queries.evidence: The trait forwards one scene point through a coverage wrapper, urban exclusion and playable-ground lookup before the final native coverage lerp.
application_queries.decision: Keep the point checked through application queries. Preserve the exact native clamp/outside/lerp order. Admit the newly clamped boundary point at that complete coordinate calculation, not by flattening and re-admitting the original point between helpers.

actual_native_kernels: Urban SpatialBuckets::at directly quantizes native spatial coordinates into the cached cell key.
CityStreetPatch::contains computes complete segment/quad containment; CityYardPatch::contains delegates solely to its complete convex-quad kernel.
CityPlotBounds::contains explicitly implements the f64 rotated-rectangle containment kernel and documents its native port. Its existing checked centre/dimensions owners must not be duplicated.

CoverageMask texel address math, native noise/finite-difference operations and actual vector/Transform assembly remain numerical endpoints. No permission to retain a naked scene point in a surrounding application record follows from those endpoints.
producer_decisions: Botanical open_understory_site and grass footprint probes create new offset coordinates. Admit each completed offset result once before checked ground/mask queries; preserve the existing five/nine probe ordering and short-circuit behavior.

Loose-stone PatchPlacement::new admits the complete source-grid-to-metres point once before urban and terrain queries. Preserve its distinct index*scale-half formula and exact envelope-radius equation.
Bevy movement/weather audio positions are native GlobalTransform observations: admit their complete X/Z projection once and preserve unavailable support. No origin or zero-height replacement.

SceneTerrain::refined produces the scene-local point at its grid-to-metres calculation. Keep that point and the canonical sampled elevation through its application callback; the complete callback equation admits its final elevation before native-buffer storage. Keep source-grid SceneTerrain::new coordinates distinct from scene-local points.

SceneTerrain::rewrite_heights similarly exposes world coordinates and absolute samples to application callbacks. Preserve checked point/elevation there and the existing row order, finite-rejection behavior and publication semantics. Do not turn this into an unchecked alias or preserve raw forwarding just to avoid adapting the few existing callbacks.

Core authoritative_surface_relief and road_surface_relief must retain the point at their application entry and admit actual computed road probes at their producer. Keep complete local noise/relief scalar equations native. Their client counterparts are cfg(test) formula mirrors; adapt existing cases without adding tests.
scope_limits: This is the P06 connected scene-point/support family, not a migration of every street/yard serialized field or every raster dimension, density, noise coefficient, radius or material enum.
Where a preexisting point is already checked, use it directly. Do not create equivalent geometry owners or take over remaining #765 city-family responsibilities.
The search yielded additional callers, not a claim that every method with a matching name is a defect. Native exclusions above were checked by receiver bodies.
Existing test-name/assertion inventory is a static preservation aid, not runtime validation. P06 source implementation is still gated on the current baseline-only CI follow-up.
